title: consulting proposal
overall_deck_description: This consulting proposal deck is designed with a modern, clean editorial aesthetic bookended by high-impact landscape imagery on the cover and closing slides, with clean white-background content layouts in between. The sequence establishes a consistent structure using a subtle light-gray top header bar (holding metadata or minimal navigation icons) and a signature two-tone (teal and orange) horizontal accent line positioned directly above left-aligned section titles. Bold, heavy sans-serif typography anchors the headlines, complemented by clean regular sans-serif body text, teal-accented numbered lists, and structured photographic collages across the internal body slides.
